# Net DNS Monitor

> Net DNS Monitor watches connectivity and DNS from the macOS menu bar and records local incident reports when a connection fails.

## Product and support

- [Net DNS Monitor](https://netdnsmonitor.com/): How the monitor diagnoses dropped connections, what the editions include, and how to install the app.
- [Privacy](https://netdnsmonitor.com/privacy/): How the website, purchases, advertising, and Mac app handle data.
- [Full site text](https://netdnsmonitor.com/llms-full.txt): A plain-text reference for the product, installation, support, and privacy.
